ideas.pitch: A hyper-local multi-agent carbon emission tracking and forecasting platform tailored for Oxford colleges, using Poisson regression and RAG to model heating and energy consumption anomalies across historic buildings.
ideas.title: Oxford Collegiate Carbon Ledger
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines rigorous forecasting methodologies from winning AI governance projects with high local relevance to Oxford university colleges and sustainability challenges.

ideas.pitch: An investigative graph intelligence platform combining LightGBM and LLMs to detect anomalies and illicit trafficking risks in the provenance chains of academic antiquities and manuscripts.
ideas.title: Bodleian Rare Manuscript AML & Provenance Graph
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the graph intelligence and LightGBM AML architecture that won the DIGITIMES AI Innovation Hackathon to an academic and cultural domain unique to Oxford.

ideas.pitch: A localized nutrition and student wellness platform that aggregates dining hall menus across Oxford colleges, delivering personalized dietary recommendations through an edge-optimized Gemini API integration.
ideas.title: Oxford Local Health & Nutrition Mesh
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the rapid, user-focused execution of the Hour Hackathon winner by targeting an immediate pain point for students living in college accommodations.

ideas.pitch: An automated satellite image monitoring pipeline using computer vision to track industrial runoff and environmental compliance along the River Thames and surrounding Oxfordshire waterways.
ideas.title: Thames Water Satellite Compliance Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages heavy technical execution and geo-spatial monitoring proven successful at the Xcelerate Hackathon, addressing a prominent local environmental concern.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent platform that distributes and audits micro-grants for Oxford student societies using USDC escrow smart contracts on Base.
ideas.title: Oxford Autonomous Micro-Grants Escrow
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies the autonomous agent and crypto-escrow integration pattern from the Synthesis Hackathon to streamline university funding distribution.
